linkedinRisk.title: Let the agent browse LinkedIn?
linkedinRisk.p1: LinkedIn's terms forbid browsing its website with automated tools. Even though the agent uses your browser, goes slowly and only reads, LinkedIn may restrict or close your account if it detects it.
linkedinRisk.p2: The risk-free alternatives are its email alerts (the “Alerts” screen) and the “Send to CandidatAI” button while you view a job.
linkedinRisk.p3: You can turn it off whenever you like. Applications are never sent on their own.
linkedinRisk.activate: Turn on at my own risk

publicRisk.detail: Besides the results list, the app will request the public page of each new job that passes your filters (with a cap per run). That's more requests to LinkedIn and therefore a higher chance it blocks your IP. Without this, jobs come in as summaries and you complete them with the “Send to CandidatAI” button.
publicRisk.p1: Once a day the app will query LinkedIn's public search (the one people see when not signed in) with this card's searches. It doesn't use your account or your cookies, goes slowly and identifies itself honestly.
publicRisk.p2: Even so, LinkedIn's terms forbid automated access, and LinkedIn may block your IP for a while (for normal browsing too). If it does, the app stops immediately and doesn't try again for a few days.
publicRisk.p3: It's for personal use. The risk-free alternatives are email alerts and the “Send to CandidatAI” button. Applications are never sent on their own.
publicRisk.download: Download it at my own risk
publicRisk.activate: Turn on at my own risk

title: Platforms
intro: Job boards your agent browses with your browser when you ask for `search-jobs`, in priority order. It only reads: it doesn't apply, save jobs on the board or solve captchas. What it finds goes to “To extract”. “Broaden search” suggests roles close to the ones you approve; you decide which to add.

add.linkedinTitle: It's saved with searching turned off, and that's what we recommend.
add.linkedinP1: LinkedIn's terms forbid browsing its website with automated tools, and it may restrict or close your account if it detects it, even if the agent uses your browser and only reads. The safe way is to get its jobs through email alerts (the “Alerts” screen) or with the “Send to CandidatAI” button.
add.linkedinP2: If you still want the agent to browse it, turn it on afterwards with its switch, at your own risk.
